subject: CloudNova marketplace enablement — follow-up and tech deep-dive slots

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Heather Lin <heather.lin@cloudnova.io>, Marco Silva <marco.silva@stratusgsi.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudNova marketplace enablement — recap + tech deep-dive options

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can get the marketplace listing and POC scheduled: 

What we heard:
- Goal: get CloudNova listed in Redwood Marketplace and validate joint POC for customer onboarding flows (auth, billing tokenization, and model routing).
- Success metrics: demo to internal GTM + a short technical POC with one pilot customer within 6 weeks.
- Constraints: CloudNova needs SSO + KMS integration details, and StratusGSI will act as implementation partner for customers in EMEA.

Proposed next step (technical deep-dive / demo): please confirm which slot works for your engineering team:
- Thu Apr 8 — 09:00–10:00 PT (16:00–17:00 CET)
- Fri Apr 9 — 13:00–14:00 PT (20:00–21:00 CET)
- Alternative: Mon Apr 12 — 10:00–11:00 PT

Agenda (30–45m):
- 10m: short marketplace enablement overview (roles & artifacts)
- 20–30m: technical deep-dive (auth/KMS, routing, model selection, expected QPS)
- 5–10m: next actions & owners (POC scope, deliverables, first customer)

I've attached a proposed POC scope doc for reference (CN-POC-scope.pdf). Please loop in any additional technical contacts (SAML/Security, Cloud infra) and let us know preferred slot.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CN-POC-scope.pdf]

Thanks Priyom — great session. We can do Fri Apr 9 but can we shift one hour later to 14:00–15:00 PT? That puts us better for our EMEA partners.

A couple asks before the tech call:
- Please include auth/KMS and billing integration confidently — those are our top questions.
- Can you share Redwood's SOC2 report and DPA template ahead of the call? Our legal will want to scan before we progress.
- I'll bring Marco (Stratus) and Raj (CloudNova AM). I may also invite our SSO lead depending on final slot.

Thanks,

Look forward to it —
